name: agents-tdd
description: Enforced test-driven development: an orchestrator drives plan -> failing tests -> independent validation -> implementation, with a fail-closed hook that blocks source writes until the tests exist, and a separate context that certifies the RED is real before GREEN may start. Use when a spec carries concrete scenarios and the tests should be the oracle rather than an afterthought — the validator exists because a test written by the same context that writes the code is not a check. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
